description:
Give the domain query tests an owning case for every query property the CLI and executor re-proofs assert, before those re-proofs are cut to wiring.

## Background

`crates/jit/src/domain/queries.rs` owns the query filters, label queries (`query_by_label`, `query_by_labels`, `query_strategic` at `:278`, `:318`, `:336`) and the available-work order, with unit and property tests. Subprocess and executor tests re-prove those semantics. In `cli_query_graph` they are `query_tests.rs` (25), `label_filter_repeatable_query_tests.rs` (17), `label_query_json_tests.rs` (7), `query_json_tests.rs` (5) and `label_hierarchy_e2e_test.rs` (4). In `fast_rules` they are `label_query_tests.rs` (12) and `label_strategic_tests.rs` (7).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: For each query property those files assert (filter membership, AND semantics, pattern matching, case sensitivity, strategic selection, empty repositories, ordering), `domain/queries.rs` has an owning test.
- [hard] REQ-02: A property already owned there is not duplicated.
title: Domain query tests own each property the query re-proofs assert
